dataset_rendition.what: the Sony extreme-dark set is distributed in at least two renditions with different pixel conventions
dataset_rendition.caveat: 5.29 is an absolute PSNR of one checkpoint on the other rendition, not a difference; the comparison is against the 22.904 that checkpoint reports on its own rendition. The other rendition is built with no gamma correction, so this is a cross-domain application, not a subtle convention difference.
